subject: Segmentation proof-of-readiness & questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@healtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Segmentation proof-of-readiness & questionnaire kickoff

Hi Sofia — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so everyone has the same page.

Call highlights:
- HealTech needs a private deployment option with strict network partitioning for models that process PHI.
- Key compliance drivers: SOC 2 Type II (in-flight), HIPAA controls for data-in-use and data-at-rest, GDPR vendor obligations for EU customers.
- Primary asks we captured: network diagram, SOC 2 timeline/status, initial vendor security questionnaire, and whether an air-gapped variant is required for the pilot.

Action items (proposed):
1) HealTech to share current SOC 2 artifact status and any interim evidence you can provide (e.g., SOC 2 Type I report, control owner list).
2) We’ll send a short vendor questionnaire (attached) for your security team to start — it focuses on encryption, key management, logging, and network boundaries.
3) If possible, please attach a simplified network sketch showing how you currently separate PHI workloads (VPCs, NATs, on-prem segments). If you have an internal architect, CC them.
4) Schedule a technical deep-dive next week with our infra engineer to validate possible private deployment topologies (air-gapped vs VPC peering).

Attachments: HealTech_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (short intake), network-sketch-request.pdf (one-page template).

Proposed times for the deep-dive: Tue 12/1 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 12/2 14:00–15:00 PT. Let me know which works.

Thanks — looking forward to getting these artifacts into the intake flow so we can map a secure deployment pattern for your use case.

—
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0112

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@healtech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HealTech Security <security@healtech.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Segmentation proof-of-readiness & questionnaire kickoff

Mina — thanks for the clear recap. Appreciated the checklist — this is helpful. Quick updates from our side: 

- SOC 2: We completed Type I last quarter and are mid-cycle for Type II; our target for a completed Type II report is end of March 2027. We can share the Type I report and our control mapping this week.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We handle PHI in scoped environments and have BAAs with downstream partners. We treat GDPR obligations seriously — our DPO copied here will follow up if specific processing records are requested.
- Network: We can provide a redacted network sketch. For the pilot we prefer a VPC-based isolated deployment with strict egress rules; air-gapped is a possibility but would be heavier operationally.

Actionables from HealTech:
1) I’ll upload the Type I SOC report and a control-owner spreadsheet to the Drive link you shared by EOD today.
2) Security will start on the vendor questionnaire but we may need a couple days for internal review.
3) Our infra lead, Raj Patel (raj.patel@healtech.com), will prepare the redacted network sketch — I’ll CC him on the next message.

We can do Tue 12/1 10:00 PT — that works for our team.

Thanks,
Sofia
Head of Product Operations, HealTech
sofia.martinez@healtech.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@healtech.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Segmentation proof-of-readiness & questionnaire kickoff

Sofia — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple technical clarifications ahead of the deep-dive so we can prep the right artifacts: 

1) When you say "VPC-based isolated deployment with strict egress rules", can you confirm whether you expect: 
   - Redwood-managed instances in your VPC (customer-hosted agents) via VPC peering/CGW, OR
   - Redwood-managed private tenancy in our Dedicated fleet with network-level tunnels into your environment?

2) For the air-gapped alternative: do you require zero internet egress (fully air-gapped), or is a controlled one-way pull-to-update mechanism acceptable? The operational difference changes our recommended topology.

3) KMS: do you use a cloud KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) for customer keys that we should integrate with, or do you require HSM-backed on-prem keys?

If you can surface answers ahead of Tue morning, we’ll bring the right network diagrams and a proposed matrix of topology options (full air-gap / VPC-isolated / hybrid).

Thanks — Karthik
Director, Deployment Architecture, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@healtech.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@healtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Segmentation proof-of-readiness & questionnaire kickoff

Perfect — thanks all. Quick summary and next steps before the Tuesday deep-dive (12/1 10:00 PT):

- Sofia: please upload the Type I SOC report + control-owner sheet to the Drive link and start the questionnaire.
- Raj: when you send the redacted sketch, a simple ASCII diagram or PDF is fine. Include IP blocks, NAT/egress points, and any on-prem corridors that carry PHI.
- HealTech answer requests: reply inline to Karthik’s three technical bullets if you can — they’ll help us pick the right artifacts to bring.

We’ll prepare three deployment sketches to review in the session:
  A) VPC-isolated (peered/TLS tunnel) with strict egress and token scoping
  B) Dedicated-tenant (Redwood-managed in a private capacity) with customer-controlled KMS
  C) Air-gapped (one-way update channel vs fully offline) — pros/cons and ops estimate

I’ve re-attached the questionnaire and included a one-page sketch template to speed the sketch delivery. If there are any legal or procurement constraints (BAA wording, data residency), please flag them ahead of the call so we can loop in Legal/Product.

Looking forward to the deep-dive.

—
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: HealTech_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx; network-sketch-request.pdf
